source.basis: Quoted evidence supports the claim; its interpretation still needs current-source checks.

text: The manager records shown in its notification setter and starts the selected timestamp there. active_this_session floors wall-clock milliseconds divided by 1000. The accepted UI manager can await NotificationScheduler.waitForActive before appending the element. Therefore these metrics measure selection and elapsed selection time, not a verified moment when pixels became visible or the user read them. Preserve the unit conversion and this wording boundary in code comments and data interpretation.
title: Describe notification telemetry as selection time rather than proven screen exposure
